snippet.title: Risk of Rain: Meridian Showcase 2
snippet.description:
Meridian is a small mod that is being worked on by me, retroPacifist and Altzeus, it's primary focus is on adding more maps to the game! 

I have decided on retexturing the tileset since it clashed with the risk of rain artstyle, i stripped some detail too because risk of rain stages arent meant to have a shit ton of detail, also retroPacifist has joined the group! He's very talended with doing enemies.

(Names of some maps won't be revealed until release)

MUSIC IN THIS STAGE IS A PLACEHOLDER, IT WILL GET ITS OWN THEME LATER ON DEVELOPMENT.

The Music is: The Killing Wind (by Naktigonis)

Mods used in this video that are not apart of Meridian:
Starstorm made by Neik
